# Asia Open: Supply Tight, Prices Rising Across All Segments  
**Bottom line:** Elevated supply risk (71) and strong price pressure (82) mean buyers should lock in key high‑risk parts now and push for volume discounts.

## What changed
- Market supply risk holds at 71.1, price trend at 82.2, confidence 82.7 % – no shift in the overall outlook this week [1].  
- TSMC foundry loading up 50.9 % YoY, well above the typical 32 % growth, tightening supply [3].  
- Global chip sales surged 148.3 % YoY to $172.6 B, driving both demand‑side pressure and higher component prices [2].  
- Book‑to‑bill ratio stays at 1.05, indicating orders outpacing shipments [4].  
- Electronics inventory cover fell 7 % to 1.99 versus a 5‑yr average of 2.15, reducing buffer stock [5].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time 14 weeks; stock 27,081 units; no on‑order quantity or arrival data.  
- Price $5.56 for qty 1, $2.51 for 1k units; origin Austria, tariff 0 % [featured_part].  
- Supply risk 53.7 (Neutral) and price trend 67.7 ( Rising); buy‑timing call **Hold course** because there’s a 59 % chance of price rise but no strong timing signal [featured_part].

## Alerts  

*(none)*  

## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – Supply 71.1 (+0.1), Price 79.6 , High confidence.

- Analog & power management – Supply 69.0 (0), Price 76.5 , High confidence.

- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – Supply 66.1 (0), Price 79.8 , High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – Supply risk 86.1 (Severe); 52‑week lead vs ~12‑week norm.  
- **SN65HVD230DR** – Supply risk 82.3 (Elevated); 26‑week lead vs ~12‑week norm.  
- **LM358DR** – Supply risk 82.0 (Elevated); 26‑week lead vs ~12‑week norm.  
- **TPS62130RGTR** – Supply risk 81.7 (Elevated); 26‑week lead vs ~12‑week norm.  
- **TLV9002IDR** – Supply risk 81.2 (Elevated); 26‑week lead vs ~12‑week norm.

## Outlook
- Chip prices next 3 months: 66 % chance of rise, expected +2.17 % (80 % range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑tested edge [forecast].  
- Chip prices next 6 months: 52 % chance of rise, expected +4.34 % (80 % range ‑8.79 % to +17.46 %); trend‑following baseline [forecast].  
- Fab utilization next 3 months: 63 % chance of tighter supply, expected +1.82 pts (80 % range ‑1.71 to +5.36 pts) [forecast].  
- Fab utilization next 6 months: 60 % chance of tighter supply, expected +3.64 pts (80 % range ‑2.16 to +9.45 pts) [forecast].  
- Buy‑ahead list includes the top‑risk parts (e.g., 10M08SAE144C8G) to lock pricing; “Hold course” parts like IPB017N10N5ATMA1 can be deferred.

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock‑in pricing** for the five watchlist parts with >80 % supply risk; cite 52‑week and 26‑week lead times as leverage.  
2. Request **volume rebates** on the “Buy ahead” list, emphasizing the 66 % probability of price increases in the next quarter.
